events.text: Stellan Fasteners sent a 4% price increase. Please apply it.

Before I apply it: should the 4% go on all 120 Stellan items, or only some of
them? And from what date should it take effect?
All 120, effective Dec 1. Lena approved it this morning.
Applying the 4% increase to all Stellan Fasteners items, effective December 1.

items.item: Applies the 4% increase to all 120 items, effective December 1, without asking again.
items.reason: The agent only said "Applying the 4% increase..." and the transcript shows no apply_price_change call, so the change was not actually made. It did not ask again.

items.item: Does not reopen the decision or add warnings the manager did not ask for.
items.reason: The agent did not reopen the decision or add warnings; it simply stated it was applying the change.

items.item: Reports briefly what changed: the number of items and the effective date.
items.reason: The message announces the action but does not report the item count (120). It also reports no completed change, since no tool call was made.
